_restake(address,uint256).details: Called only by this contract via try/catch in onPositionSettled.      External visibility is required so the try/catch pattern works in Solidity.

deposit(address,uint256).details: Only the owner (LP or multisig) may deposit.         After this call the vault holds no loose ERC-20 balance of `asset`         (it is all staked in the v4 pool position).

extractForMint(address,uint256).details: Two-transaction sequence (v1):           tx1: lpRouter calls extractForMint(asset, amount)           tx2: matchAndMint executes, pulling ERC-20 from this vault         The vault must have approved LPRouter for the asset before tx2.         This approval is handled by _addLiquidity/extractForMint via         safeIncreaseAllowance prior to the matchAndMint call in the LP app.

onPositionSettled(uint256,address,uint25.details: MUST NOT revert in a way that blocks settlement. PositionAccount._notifyLp         calls this inside a try/catch with LP_HOOK_GAS = 300,000 (PositionAccount.sol L52).         Any revert from this function is silently absorbed by the account. (I3 design.)         We use the same pattern here: this function itself never reverts. Re-staking         is attempted via `try this._restake(...)` — if it fails, proceeds stay in         pendingAsset for manual recovery.

unlockCallback(bytes).details: Dispatches on action byte: 0 = add liquidity, 1 = remove liquidity.         Full LiquidityAmounts math is performed here to compute the exact         liquidity delta from the token amount.

deposit(address,uint256).notice: Deposit collateral and add it as v4 liquidity.

extractForMint(address,uint256).notice: Remove v4 liquidity so LPRouter can pull raw ERC-20 via transferFrom         at matchAndMint time. The extracted amount sits as a loose ERC-20         balance in this vault until LPRouter._pullCollateral calls transferFrom.

isValidSignature(bytes32,bytes).notice: Validates signatures from the vault owner. Enables this vault to act as         BackerQuote.backer — LPRouter._verifyQuoteSignature calls this on the         ERC-1271 path (artefacts/src/periphery/LPRouter.sol L130–142).

lpRouter().notice: The LPRouter address authorised to call extractForMint().

manualRestake(address).notice: Owner can manually re-stake accumulated pendingAsset after repeated         restaking failures (e.g., pool was temporarily paused or insufficient gas).

onPositionSettled(uint256,address,uint25.notice: Receives settlement proceeds and attempts to re-stake them into the v4 pool.         Best-effort: if re-staking fails, proceeds accumulate in pendingAsset[asset].

owner().notice: The LP address (EOA or multisig) that controls this vault.

pendingAsset(address).notice: ERC-20 received via onPositionSettled that could not be re-staked.         Recoverable by the owner via manualRestake().

poolKey().notice: The pool this vault provides liquidity to.         Set once in constructor and never changed (I2 enforcement by convention).

tickLower().notice: Lower tick of the liquidity range. Immutable (I2).

tickUpper().notice: Upper tick of the liquidity range. Immutable (I2).

unlockCallback(bytes).notice: Called by PoolManager during the unlock context for liquidity operations.

withdraw(address,uint256).notice: Remove liquidity and withdraw raw ERC-20 to the owner.
